current_observation.interpretation: The packet-cortex boundary is claimed/routed but not yet executable evidence at review time. The booleans in the handoff acceptance object are requirements, not proof of satisfaction.

falsifier_invariants.requirement: A repeated packet_id with byte-identical payload must not advance turn state, memory state, tool ownership, output epoch or VoiceOutcome twice; a repeated packet_id with different payload must fail closed as identity corruption.

Legal ASR partial revisions for one turn must be distinguishable from sequence gaps/reordering. A newer partial may replace prior uncommitted transcript text without causing duplicate semantic commit.
A missing sequence number must never be silently skipped. Buffer, reject or explicit recovery is acceptable, but the policy and resulting state transition must be deterministic and traceable.
Barge-in/cancel must advance or invalidate the active output/tool ownership epoch so any late generation chunk, TTS chunk or tool completion from the cancelled epoch cannot leak into the next turn.

Partially heard output may create an observational VoiceOutcome/reentry record with bounded heard_fraction, but must not be confused with semantic memory commit. Unheard tail and fully unheard cancelled output remain noncommittable.

Within one output packet/epoch, heard_fraction must remain in [0,1] and never decrease. completed requires the implementation's explicit heard/commit rule; interrupted/cancelled must not become completed by a later stale event.
Snapshot/restart/reconnect must not resurrect cancelled output, stale tool ownership, superseded partials or an old endpoint timer. Only admitted durable session facts may re-enter.

A tool result must bind to its originating session_id, turn_id and ownership/epoch identity. A result arriving after interruption may be retained as evidence but cannot silently mutate the successor turn.
WAIT/backchannel behavior must not close the turn, mint a final answer outcome, or allow a backchannel utterance to overwrite the user's still-open input turn.
Semantic close and silence close must be deterministic under the same packet trace; duplicate close packets are idempotent and post-close input requires explicit reopen/new-session policy.
Long-session fixtures must demonstrate bounded retained transient packet state rather than unbounded seen-id/partial/output growth. Any compaction must preserve replay/idempotency guarantees.
The adapter may project packet/cortex state but must not become a competing canonical UnifiedDB, EffectGate/EffectJournal, GWT truth, release, receipt or runtime authority.

Executed packet tests must bind an explicit zero outbound model/ASR/TTS inference-call counter or equivalent network isolation evidence; absence of calls in code review alone is insufficient runtime proof.

Repository/S1/S2 packet tests may promote only packet/controller component scope. Acoustic quality, captured-audio WER, AEC, physical speaker-heard output, physical latency, device acceptance, whole voice E2E and whole product remain zero.

next_exact_action: The current Trigger4 owner should implement against the existing claimed boundary, include these falsifiers in the deterministic fixture suite, run the exact-source packet logic on an admitted LOCAL_SOLO VPS sandbox, and emit a bound receipt. If code has landed before this review is consumed, treat this packet as an independent falsifier checklist rather than a request for a successor implementation.
